strategies.name: vwap_20sma_trend_following_2m

entry_sequence.action: Wait for the first two-minute candle after the bell to close above the 20 Simple Moving Average (SMA) and the Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP).
entry_sequence.rationale: This confirms a bullish bias for the session.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for a following candle to confirm the high of the candle that closed above the 20 SMA.
If the price pulls back into the VWAP, this is a good buying opportunity to lower the dollar cost average.
entry_sequence.rationale: VWAP acts as support during a bullish trend.

entry_sequence.action: Hold the position as long as the VWAP and the 20 SMA are trending higher.
entry_sequence.rationale: The 20 SMA acts as a trailing stop.

entry_sequence.action: If the price closes below the 20 SMA, use that as an indication to exit the trade.
entry_sequence.rationale: The 20 SMA serves as the trailing stop/exit signal.

entry_sequence.action: If the price loses both VWAP and the 20 SMA collectively and then closes below VWAP, look to short the rejection of VWAP and the 20 SMA.
entry_sequence.rationale: Reversal signal for a short entry.

stop.rationale: The speaker uses the previous wick/low point as a stop, which is a form of structural stop.

strategies.stop_management: Hold the position as long as the VWAP and the 20 SMA are trending higher, using the 20 SMA as a trailing stop.

targets.rationale: Sell for profits into the upper channel of the VWAP bands.
Sell for profits into the lower channel of the VWAP bands.
